images.title: Sharing 412 among 4 plates with a regrouped ten
images.purpose: Show 412 as base ten blocks shared among 4 plates: 1 hundred on each plate, no ten on any plate, and the single ten regrouped into ones that are shared.
images.composition: The starting blocks on the left and four plates in a row on the right, each with one flat and three cubes.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Left group at x 60 to 520: 4 hundreds flats as orange #E69F00 squares 80 px wide in 2 rows of 2 (x 80 and x 180; y 200 and y 300); 1 tens rod, a blue #0072B2 rectangle 24 px wide and 120 px high with 9 thin white lines across it, at x 300 and y 200 to 320; 2 ones cubes, reddish purple #CC79A7 squares 36 px wide, at x 80 and x 130, y 420. Above the left group the label 4 hundreds, 1 ten and 2 ones at x 290 and y 140 (40 px, dark). Right group: 4 plates, each a white circle 150 px across with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline, in a row with centres at (700, 330), (870, 330), (1040, 330) and (1210, 330). Each plate holds exactly 1 orange flat, 60 px wide, in its upper half and exactly 3 purple cubes, 22 px wide, in a row in its lower half, so 4 flats and 12 cubes on the plates in all; no plate holds a tens rod. Under the plates, centred at x 955 and y 470, the label 1 hundred, 0 tens and 3 ones on each plate (40 px, dark). Between the groups a grey #6B7280 curved arrow (4 px) runs from the single rod of the left group to the cubes of the plates, with the label regroup 1 ten into 10 ones (36 px, dark) above it at x 600 and y 200. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The single ten cannot be shared among 4 plates, so each plate gets 0 tens; regrouping it into 10 ones gives 12 ones, 3 on each plate.
images.description: Base ten blocks for 412 shared among 4 plates: 1 hundred and 3 ones on each plate and 0 tens, after regrouping the ten.
images.context: Concept image for Regroup Hundreds, Hold the Place with Zero. The numbers are the plan's own worked example (412 shared among 4), not a number of any book question.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student why no plate gets a ten. The slip to watch: leaving out the 0 in the quotient 103.

image_decisions.why: The blocks shared among four plates show why the tens place holds a zero.
